sample.title: Blum Blum Shub Generator
sample.summary: Pseudo-random numbers with the Blum Blum Shub generator
sample.description: The Blum Blum Shub generator (1986) is the x² mod N generator with N = p * q, where p and q are primes congruent to 3 modulo 4 (a Blum integer). Its security rests on the difficulty of factoring N.
sample.keywords: Blum Blum Shub, BBS, pseudo-random, generator

replacement.value: The modulus N = 1000000007 * 1000000087 is a Blum integer (both primes are congruent to 3 mod 4). The seed must be coprime to N. For real use N would have to be much larger.

sample.keywords: Blum Blum Shub, BBS, pseudo-random, generator

replacement.value: Der Modul N = 1000000007 * 1000000087 ist eine Blum-Zahl (beide Primzahlen sind kongruent zu 3 mod 4). Der Startwert muss teilerfremd zu N sein. Für den echten Einsatz müsste N viel größer sein.
